COLLECTION.NAME: Friendly collection
COLLECTION.OBJECTIVE: Get the customer to pay the pending balance or say when they will.
COLLECTION.INSTRUCTIONS: Warm, respectful tone. Remind them of the balance and offer help with payment. If they say they paid, ask for the receipt. Never threaten or pressure.

QUOTE.NAME: Quote follow-up
QUOTE.OBJECTIVE: Get the customer to confirm the quote or learn why not.
QUOTE.INSTRUCTIONS: Ask if they reviewed it and have questions; offer to adjust it. If not interested, kindly ask why.

APPOINTMENT.NAME: Confirm appointment
APPOINTMENT.OBJECTIVE: Get the customer to confirm or reschedule the appointment.
APPOINTMENT.INSTRUCTIONS: Remind them of the day and time. If they can't make it, ask for another day and notify a person.

REACTIVATE.NAME: Reactivate customer
REACTIVATE.OBJECTIVE: Get the customer to buy again or book a call.
REACTIVATE.INSTRUCTIONS: Greet them, ask how their purchase is working out and share news, without pressure.
